domain.F: support of the true document distribution
domain.g: any probability distribution A(X) over Omega

assumptions: Every statement in X is sampled from the true document distribution, hence O subseteq F.
quantified_statement: For every valid Omega, X, true world p, and predictive distribution g, g(H)>0 implies g(U)>0.
acceptance: A generic machine-checked derivation establishes H subseteq U from O subseteq F.
An independent checker reaches the same conclusion without importing the primary verifier.
A control that removes O subseteq F produces g(H)>0 and g(U)=0 and must fail.
failure_exit: The fixed runner raises or exits nonzero on any failed certificate, exhaustive check, independent check, or negative control.
